articles.summary: Every quantum computing company publishes an ambitious roadmap, but DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) is designed to answer a practical bottom-line question: will these systems deliver more computational value than they cost? In this conversation, Jeff Rothblum sits down with Dr. Rick Muller, Chief Scientist at IonQ Federal, to break down why Stage C is the ultimate “prove it” phase - requiring real-hardware validation against a common yardstick. They discuss how IonQ’s record gate fidelities, "walking cat" architecture, and cryptographic resource modeling connect into a single path toward fault tolerance, and what utility-scale systems will mean for materials science, clean energy, and national defense.
articles.title: The “Prove It” Stage: What DARPA’s Stage C Means for IonQ
